concept: Snowball Edge: offline transfer of large data volumes
tests: Choosing a way to migrate 200 TB when a network transfer would take months.
expected: AWS Snowball Edge — physical shipping of a device. Triggers: "200 TB", "internet link would take months".
why_not: DataSync and Transfer Acceleration hit the same slow link; Direct Connect 1 Gbps — weeks to provision plus a long transfer.
